crossRefs.note: You have rebuked the proud who are cursed, who wander from your commandments.
The proud have smeared a lie upon me. With my whole heart, I will keep your precepts.
Have mercy on us, Yahweh, have mercy on us, for we have endured much contempt.
Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scoffing of those who are at ease, with the contempt of the proud.

translations.web: The arrogant mock me excessively, but I don’t swerve from your law.
translations.bsb: The arrogant utterly deride me, but I do not turn from Your law.
translations.kjv: The proud have had me greatly in derision: yet have I not declined from thy law.
translations.asv: The proud have had me greatly in derision: Yet have I not swerved from thy law.
